text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Big sis,
can I really have this bag!?

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that big sis's favorite?!
You said, 'It's super easy to fit shoes into!'

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. If hand-me-downs make you happy,
go right ahead and take them~.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
...With my older sister already graduated,
I really want Tsu-chan to do her best in her place!

text_block_list.name: Tablet Voice
text_block_list.text:
“Now heading into the 4th corner,
this is the Derby Point!
The Umamusume make their moves all at once, but—”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is that footage of Lady Symboli Rudolf's Japan Derby~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
The President was amazing in this race, too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "...At this Derby, the President caused an astonishing stir."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Symboli Rudolf still hasn't made her move!? She's in sixth, seventh position! What's happening to Rudolf—!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The developments from the 3rd corner were crucial, and the President "failed to stretch."
She couldn't catch the Umamusume in front of her either.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
People panicked and cried out.
"Why isn't she speeding up?!" "Did she run out of stamina?!"
"She's not going to make it in time!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —"Even that Rudolf might lose."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That can't be right!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The President made her move on the final straight after that!
And with that, she brilliantly took first place!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Blow away all your worries and anxieties!
Show them you're "unquestionably strong"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That she's an "absolute" existence who won't lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Wait, Bright-san, you're covered in mud!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, I'm so sorry for rambling on!
Even though you were training
until this late hour...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Nooot a thing,
please don't worry your head about it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I was the one who called out first. Looking into your eyes, I just couldn't help myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I have come to realize once again that admiration is something that makes our eyes sparkle~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We certainly can't have things looking gloomy~.
I shall make everything sparkle and shine as well~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
――……
Bright-san……?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaan!
Over here, there's an open spot over here~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, at Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's request, we visited
Kyoto Racecourse—the venue for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san is in Gate 5, Bracket 4...!
That's the exact same gate Mejiro McQueen-san was in when she won back-to-back Tenno Sho (Spring)s!
choice_data_list: Huh! You're knowledgeable about the Mejiro family too?
Huh! You're knowledgeable about the Mejiro family too?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahem!
...is what I'd like to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's just last-minute cramming.
I simply wanted to truly understand my senior roommate.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Bright-san was an umamusume of the Mejiro family who held a deep yearning, wishing, 'I want to be just like the Mejiro family's older sisters.'

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Last year, though, I fell just one step short.
I couldn't win a GⅠ."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: B-But! The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the race the Mejiro family cherishes above all others!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: So today, I really want you to win.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I just wanted you to reach the one you look up to.
choice_data_list: ...You're right, let's cheer with all our might!
...You're right, let's cheer with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
*Inhaaaaale*...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Bria—whoaa?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *cough* *hack*!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ha... hahaha! I just choked a bit!
I'm fine! More importantly—...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Bright-san, do your beeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You certainly have a friend
with a very carrying voice, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Bright, I know of your hardships.
Yet you kept running, and arrived here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, claim your Shield.
So that you may become who you wish to be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We're watching too.
Right until the very end, when you unleash that Mejiro radiance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Both McQueen and I. Everyone in the Mejiro family—

text_block_list.name: McQueen & Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—I believe in you.
—I have faith in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Lady McQueen.
Elder Sister Ryan...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I am off—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class GⅠ Tenno Sho (Spring), with the Spring Shield on the line!
Leading the pack on this prestigious stage is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright finishes in 1st!!
Taking 1st place is Mejiro Bright!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Shield goes to Mejiro!
Spring has returned once more to Mount Yotei!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Nnnnngh...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer!!
Bright-san, Bright-san is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san's eyes are...
...sparkling so brightly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAHH――!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Bright!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bright!!
You're... you're truly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —It is the pride of the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah... Aaaah...
Thank you so much...!
Thank you so, so much...!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOAAAH, now THAT is a Mejiro!
As expected of Mejiro Bright!
A true Umamusume of the Mejiro lineage!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(—So this was Bright-san's
'absolute'.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(The thing I've always dreamed of,
always believed I would achieve.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it, there really ARE "absolutes"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the bullet train back.
Just as we arrived in Tokyo,
she murmured as if filled with conviction.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi understands now, once again!
As long as you keep wishing with all your heart, the day you reach what you yearn for will come!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please watch me.
Just like President Rudolf, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —I will prove my "absolute strength" in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Working on your day off again today? Overtime on the weekend?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho.
Preparation is necessary for everything, after all. Thoroughness is key.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
We will not repeat the Satsuki Sho.
...Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written in the notebook were the plans for
the "Japanese Derby" and the "Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I circle the date over and over with a pen. Again and again in bright red, making sure it really stands out.
choice_data_list: ...Even if it's just for the very end...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We can't set our sights on the Nippon Derby just yet.
We have to monitor her condition until the last minute,
and withdraw if she isn't ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Still, no matter what happens.
I will make it in time, at least for the final race of the Classic Triple Crown,
the Kikuka Sho.
